game_title: Rounding Range – Crater Lake Edge Trial
game_concept: A puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Crater Lake Edge, the edge of a glowing crater: the lava scout must handle lava imps while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Rounding Range: Use round() and abs() to snap messy measurements into valid slots.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Crater Lake Edge: the edge of a glowing crater
core_gameplay_loop: In Crater Lake Edge, repeat each round: Use round() and abs() to snap messy measurements into valid slots. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the slot_matches value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the smelter using at most 10 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 10 before the smelter is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 1 (intro tier): Rounding Range
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how slot_matches changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against lava imps in Crater Lake Edge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The smelter reached with actions_used <= 10.
